raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: xtcocotools
  version: "1.14.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6434382784d206204d2a1b491dba359ff3464a2b9eb5890fbc0d868cad4e810f
  patches:
    - numpy-array-owndata.patch

build:
  number: 6
  script:
    - python -c "import os; content = open('setup.py').read().replace('version=get_version(),', f\"version='{os.environ['PKG_VERSION']}',\"); open('setup.py', 'w').write(content)"
    - python -c "from pathlib import Path; p = Path('requirements.txt'); p.write_text('\n'.join(line for line in p.read_text().splitlines() if not line.lower().startswith(('cython', 'setuptools'))) + '\n')"
    - python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - numpy
        - python
  host:
    - cython
    - numpy
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools >=18.0
  run:
    - matplotlib-base
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - xtcocotools
        - xtcocotools.mask
  - script:
      - python -c "import numpy as np; from xtcocotools import mask; arr = np.asfortranarray([[0, 1], [1, 1]], dtype=np.uint8); rle = mask.encode(arr); assert int(mask.area(rle)) == 3; assert np.array_equal(mask.decode(rle), arr)"
      - pip check
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/jin-s13/xtcocoapi
  repository: https://github.com/jin-s13/xtcocoapi
  summary: Extended COCO-API
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
